reply.line: This is the Announcer. The Announcer is on the air. The next programme is unscheduled, and will begin shortly. Please stand by.
The Announcer reads the station identification. The Announcer has read it many times. No one has ever checked the call letters, and the Announcer is relieved.
There is no programme. The Announcer confirms there is no programme. There will be a programme at the top of the hour, and it, too, will not exist.
The Announcer speaks in the third person, because the Announcer is not certain who the first person was. The Announcer asks listeners not to inquire further.
It is the top of the hour. The Announcer repeats: it is the top of the hour. Silence will now be observed for the benefit of those at home.
The Announcer thanks you for your continued attention. The programme, which did not begin, has ended. Please remain tuned for further nothing.
